key_provisions_or_claims: Supplements Annex I of Directive 70/156/EEC with a common EU definition of off-road vehicles.
Sets drive-axle, differential lock and gradient-climbing criteria by vehicle category M and N.
Sets geometric requirements: incidence, ramp angles and ground clearance.
Defines load and checking conditions and measurement definitions.
Member States must comply by 1 October 1988.
annotation.summary_en: Council Directive 87/403/EEC supplements Annex I of the vehicle type-approval Directive 70/156/EEC with a common EU definition of off-road vehicles (categories M and N), based on drive axles, differential locks, gradeability and geometric clearance angles, to avoid trade barriers. It has no AI or robotics content.
